title: What is the border sum of the second grid?
description: The four sides of the book's second hollow grid are added one number at a time, with a plus number moving up and a minus number moving down. All four sides give the same total, which is the border sum. The top row is added again in another order as a check.
teaching_notes: One idea: add each side one number at a time and keep every minus sign, and the four totals agree. Watch for students who drop the minus signs and add only the digits.

video_script.why: The child adds the four sides of the second hollow grid and finds the border sum.
video_script.substitution: The book's own second hollow grid, with the numbers on each side added one at a time.
video_script.anchor: a square of nine tiles from the book, with the middle tile missing
video_script.payoff_line: All four sums are negative three, so the border sum is negative three.

final_answer.value: Border sum is -3 (all four sums are -3)
final_answer.spoken: the border sum is negative three, and all four sums are negative three

hold_back: Border sum is -3 (all four sums are -3)
maths_rules: grid: top row 5, -3, -5; middle row 0, (empty), -5; bottom row -8, -2, 7
add one number at a time: a plus number moves up, a minus number moves down
check: top row in another order, 5 + (-5) = 0, then 0 + (-3) = -3
all four sums are -3, so the border sum is -3
video_script.design: The hollow grid with each side lit in turn and added in two small steps on an upright number line, teal for moving up and amber for moving down.

beats.on_screen: a small title card From your book; a square of nine tiles with the middle tile missing, holding the numbers 5, -3, -5, 0, -5, -8, -2, 7

marks.book: the title card From your book appears
marks.grid: the hollow grid of tiles appears with its numbers
marks.ask: the four sides of the grid light up one by one

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book about a grid with the middle tile missing.
<bookmark mark='grid'/>The numbers on the tiles are plus and minus numbers.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>The book asks us to add the numbers along each of the four sides.
What do you think the four sides add up to?

beats.on_screen: the hollow grid stays on the board
narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: an upright number line; a marker moves up for a plus number and down for a minus number; the label border sum appears beside the four sides of the grid

marks.move: a plus number moves the marker up and a minus number moves it down
marks.name: the four sides of the grid light up and the label border sum appears

beats.colours: teal for moving up, amber for moving down
beats.moves_through: the marker slides along the number line
narration: <bookmark mark='move'/>To add numbers with signs, think of moving on an upright number line.
A plus number moves us up. A minus number moves us down.
<bookmark mark='name'/>Suppose all four sides of a grid add up to one number.
That number is called the border sum.

beats.on_screen: Given: top row 5, -3, -5; middle row 0, empty, -5; bottom row -8, -2, 7

marks.given: the three rows of the grid are written

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, a hollow grid with a top row, a middle row and a bottom row.

beats.on_screen: To find: the sum of each of the four sides, and the border sum
narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the sum of each side, and then the border sum.

beats.colours: teal for up, amber for down
beats.moves_through: the marker moves down the number line
narration: <bookmark mark='row'/>Step one, add the top row, one number at a time.
<bookmark mark='first'/>Five plus negative three is two, and <bookmark mark='second'/>two plus negative five is negative three.

beats.colours: teal for up, amber for down
beats.moves_through: the marker moves down, then up the number line
narration: <bookmark mark='row'/>Step two, add the bottom row.
<bookmark mark='first'/>Negative eight plus negative two is negative ten, and <bookmark mark='second'/>negative ten plus seven is negative three.

beats.colours: teal for up, amber for down
beats.moves_through: the marker stays, then moves down the number line
narration: <bookmark mark='col'/>Step three, add the left column.
<bookmark mark='first'/>Five plus zero is five, and <bookmark mark='second'/>five plus negative eight is negative three.

beats.colours: teal for up, amber for down
beats.moves_through: the marker moves down, then up the number line
narration: <bookmark mark='col'/>Step four, add the right column.
<bookmark mark='first'/>Negative five plus negative five is negative ten, and <bookmark mark='second'/>negative ten plus seven is negative three.

beats.on_screen: Step 5, check: the top row in another order: 5 + (-5) = 0, then 0 + (-3) = -3, the same as before

marks.check: the top row lights up again with the order changed
marks.again: 5 + (-5) = 0, then 0 + (-3) = -3 is written and matched to Step 1

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>Step five, check the top row by adding in another order.
<bookmark mark='again'/>Five plus negative five is zero, and zero plus negative three is negative three, the same as before.

beats.on_screen: Answer: Border sum is -3 (all four sums are -3)

marks.line: the four totals line up in a row
marks.ans: a bracket joins them and the payoff line glows
marks.sum: the number -3 is boxed beside each side of the grid

narration: <bookmark mark='line'/>Put the four sums side by side, and they are all the same.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>All four sums are negative three, so the border sum is negative three.
<bookmark mark='sum'/>Each side of the grid gives the same total.
